description.value:
You always know when your own constellation is ascendant and what its aspect is. You know nothing of the other twelve.

When the day's sign is your Cloth's:

  • Ascendant (any aspect): you gain your Cloth's Ascendant Boon, and your Techniques heighten as though you were 4 levels higher.
  • Exalted: you gain your Cloth's Zenith Boon instead, and your Techniques heighten as though you were 8 levels higher.

The sky's position wakes the Cloth; its energy only decides which boon you get. A Saint stands untouched in a Malefic sky while everyone around them suffers — that is @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Unfailing Cosmo].

Odds: Ascendant 1 in 13 (7.69%); Zenith 1 in 260 (0.385%). The GM schedules Zeniths — that scene is the whole class.

The extra heightening is automated on each Technique's damage. Riders that scale with heightening but aren't damage — extra targets, longer range, wider bursts — are in each Technique's text and applied by hand.
